QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Those Knights Aren't Right
QuestInfo.0: Why are people ostracizing the Knights? See what 10 Boogies has to say.
QuestInfo.1: 10 Boogies explained the bad blood between the Knights and the Resistance.
QuestInfo.2: You learned about why the people in Edelstein ostracize the Knights, and about the Black Wings' ongoing propaganda campaign.
